reason: Butler note creates and edits are written by Core instead of a browser handoff, so terminal and Workbench chats save them. butler_notes.py: create derives a UUIDv5 note ID from a required request_id, validates with the Core note validator and relation service, replays an identical retry and refuses changed content under the same key; update checks the revision and keeps other metadata; both read back and return core_records_saved with a note_saved hint. Delete stays browser-confirmed but returns deleted:false with an honest web-app-confirmation message. UI: nebulaAssistantActions parses note_saved (and no longer turns note_create/note_update into browser writes), NebulaControlAssistant refreshes Notes, butlerNoteAction is deletion-only.
